query: ok so our b2b saas app has grown to 17 items in the left sidebar and support keeps getting tickets from people who can't find billing exports or the audit log. i've got the full list of pages in nav.yaml. can you work out how to regroup this, what to call the groups, and what should move under settings?

We're merging two marketing sites (acme.com and getacme.io, around 400 pages between them) into one. I need a proposed sitemap, URL rules, and a plan for which old pages get redirected where. Crawl export is at ~/Downloads/screaming-frog-both.csv

the blog has 312 posts and 480 tags, half of which are near duplicates like 'remote-work' and 'remote working' and 'wfh'. posts are markdown in content/posts. help me get this down to something sane that we can actually keep clean going forward

Our Confluence space for engineering is a mess, nobody can find the runbooks, there are 900 pages and people just search and give up. How should it be organized? I can export the page tree if that helps

I want to run a tree test on our new help centre structure before we build it. Can you draft the tree from help-centre-outline.md, write the tasks, and tell me what success rates I should be looking for?

we have four product areas in our app switcher named Discover, Solutions, Hub and Insights and new users have no idea what any of them are. what should these be called and is four even the right number of top level buckets

Building a recipe app and trying to decide how recipes should be grouped and filtered, by cuisine, by meal, by diet, by time? there's about 2k recipes. whats the right content model and what facets should be there. also what does the mobile tab bar look like
can you audit the information architecture of our docs site at docs.northwind.dev? we keep adding sections and the left nav is 5 levels deep now

Our online store has 6,000 SKUs and the category tree was built by three different merchandisers. Products live in multiple places and the breadcrumbs don't match the URLs. I need a restructure proposal that merch can sign off on. Category export is at data/categories.csv
design the structure for a new internal wiki for a 60 person company, HR, finance, product, eng. what are the sections, who owns what, and how do we stop it turning into a junk drawer in a year
the hamburger menu on mobile doesn't close when you tap a link, it's in src/components/Nav.tsx. can you fix it and add a slide animation
our sitemap.xml is generating urls with trailing slashes and google search console is complaining. the generator is scripts/build-sitemap.js, please fix
add a 301 from /pricing-old to /pricing in our nginx config, it's in deploy/nginx/site.conf, then reload
help me reorganize the src folder in our monorepo, the utils dir has 200 files and imports are a tangle. want a feature-based layout and a codemod to move things
design the database schema for product categories with nested parents and many to many tags in postgres, need the migrations too. we expect about 50k categories
write the user flow for our password reset, every screen, the branch for expired links and the error states, so engineering can build it next sprint
restyle the top nav so it looks less dated, we want a floating pill bar with a blur background and better hover states. tokens are in theme.css
we need to restructure the design team, currently 9 designers under one manager across 4 product areas. what org structure would you suggest and how should i roll it out
classify these 8,000 support tickets in tickets.csv into categories using an LLM and give me a python script with a confusion matrix against the hand-labelled 500
i need an interview guide for talking to 8 customers about how they currently find reports in our product, 45 min sessions, plus a screener for recruiting them
